title: Dynegy Moss Landing Power Plant Hybrid: Phase 56H Evidence Decision
summary: CPUC's July 14, 2026 update says its Generation and Energy Storage Section is conducting an ongoing investigation into the January 16, 2025 Moss Landing incident after an initial January 22, 2025 site visit. Phase 56H decision: The official rail is current, but the selected evidence state remains Partially Closed because the investigation and corrective-action review are not final.
key_findings: Highest-value missing record: Final regulator investigation and corrective-action closure.
Evidence state: Partially Closed to Partially Closed.
Continuation rule: Reopen when CPUC publishes the formal investigation or audit report, facility response, or closure notice.
